audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Ziggs six of seven stages — the packet flags it directly against a 14.29% win rate — and the difficulty block contradicted itself, labelled EVEN but rated 8/10 and called 'Hard'.
audit.why: The mirror settled the chart as Ziggs, Skill, Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Skill, Ziggs and brought difficulty to 6/10 to match the EVEN label. Levels 4-5 and 6 are hers: Flawless Duet stuns from 850 and Marks you, and Marked targets refresh Bladesurge.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 through 4 flipped on both layers as one group, ratings rebuilt, and the difficulty line brought into agreement with the EVEN label.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as your window with no numbers behind it.
audit.why: Vanguard's Edge is 125/105/85s at 950 and leaves a damaging, slowing wall. Flawless Duet 16s down to 10s at 850. Bladesurge 10s to 6s at 600 for 15 mana, refreshing on Marked or dying targets. Defiant Dance 20s at 825. Your Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 — she gets her stun back before you get your escape back.
audit.corrected: The 16s-versus-20s comparison is now stated in mid, and Level 6 names Vanguard's Edge with its real cooldown and the wall that takes your escape route.

audit.whatIsWrong: Her passive was called 'shred' in three fields, the reset chain was attributed to minions only, Bladesurge's healing was never mentioned, and Defiant Dance was never mentioned at all.
audit.why: Ionian Fervor is stacking attack speed that adds bonus on-hit damage at max stacks — no armour or MR reduction anywhere in it. Bladesurge refreshes on any Marked target as well as on a kill, and Flawless Duet is what applies the Mark, so the reset chain runs through her stun, not just through low minions. Bladesurge also heals her, which is what makes Grievous Wounds timing decide the long trade. And Defiant Dance reduces physical damage only, so your bombs go through it in full — a real advantage the page never claimed.
audit.corrected: Shred removed everywhere, the Mark-to-reset chain stated, anti-heal added, and the Defiant Dance damage-type gap made explicit.

notes: Fourth page in this run to describe Ionian Fervor as armour/MR shred — it is stacking attack speed plus bonus on-hit at max stacks. A champion-wide grep of champ-data/content/irelia.js for 'shred' is worth someone's time. The packet win rate here is 14.29% on 7 games, far off the mirror's overall figure, so I followed the mirror's chart rather than this tiny sample. Not asserted: whether Hexplosive Minefield's slow prevents Bladesurge (the derived grounding flag sits on her E, not on my E), and whether Satchel Charge's knockup can move her out of a charging Defiant Dance.
